The Full Moon in Scorpio on April 23rd, 2024, illuminates the depths of our inner world, revealing the mysteries that lie within. As the Moon "dances" with the Sun, it awakens our primal instincts, stirring the passions and desires that lie hidden. "The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall" - Nelson Mandela - as we confront our fears and insecurities.

This Full Moon in Scorpio is a call to explore the darkest corners of our psyche, to confront the shadows that haunt us. "The truth is rarely pure and never simple" - Oscar Wilde - and yet, it is in these moments of vulnerability that we discover our greatest strength. Will you rise to the challenge, or will you succumb to the darkness? The choice is yours.
